basic_info.description: Perched atop in San Francisco's coveted Lake District, this 3-bedroom, 1.25-bath flat blends classic charm with modern updates. Douglas fir stairs lead you to the bright top floor, where refinished hardwood floors and designer fixtures fill the space.  The living room, anchored by a fireplace and a built-in cabinet, flows into the formal dining room through elegant parlor doors. The dining room also features a fireplace and custom built-ins along with stained glass doors, creating a sophisticated setting for gatherings. The adjacent kitchen offers new stainless steel appliances and a large laundry room.  All three bedrooms are well-sized with deep closets and large windows with the front bedroom framed by a bay window and two bedrooms facing the rear backyard. The long hallway includes a half bath, a full bath, and a generous walk-in closet.  Outside, a shared, landscaped backyard with fruit trees provides a serene escape. A one-car parking space and additional garage storage add rare city convenience. Ideally located, this home is minutes from Mountain Lake, Park Presidio trails, and an abundance of local cafes, restaurants, and shops, with easy access to MUNI and highways. This top-floor residence offers an exceptional opportunity for comfort and convenience with much charm!
